subject: english
question: Write a paragraph on 'Golden Fiber of Bangladesh'
answer: Jute famously known as the golden fiber of Bangladesh is one of the country's most important natural resources and has been a corner stone of its economy for centuries. Renowned for its golden, silky appearance and durability, jute is used to make a wide range of eco-friendly products such as sacks, bags, ropes and carpets. Bangladesh is one of the world's leading producers and exporters of jute, and the crop plays a vital role in the livelihood of millions of farmers and workers. Beyond its economic value, jute is also celebrated for being biodegradable and sustainable, making it an important resource in the global fight against plastic pollution.
